title: GridGreen
description: A static analyzer that estimates the CO2, GPU-hours and kWh of a training script, then recommends greener model swaps and low-carbon scheduling windows. Won the DataHacks 2026 Cloud Track.

title: Doppelgamer
description: An LLM inference benchmarking framework that plays seeded multi-turn games against HuggingFace and vLLM engines, tracking TTFT, TPOT and KV-cache growth.

title: MediRare
description: A multimodal misdiagnosis-detection pipeline for rare autoimmune diseases, combining clinical NLP, figure classification and a knowledge graph.

title: MediDB
description: A clinical decision-support system built on four databases: PostgreSQL for EHR data, a Neo4j drug-interaction graph, Qdrant semantic search over FAERS adverse-event reports, and a MongoDB audit trail.

title: NYC Taxi Big Data Pipeline
description: A distributed pipeline that turns 3.4 billion NYC taxi records into a 2.9M-row feature table with PyArrow, Dask and Spark.

title: DSC 209R Project 2: Deceptive Visualization
description: Two opposing visualizations of the same IMF climate disaster data.
